interface.longDescription: Packages the Augnes Codex skill for explicit continuity, setup, and memory-reuse requests. Current repository resumption delegates to the reviewed Augnes Operator and Companion owners; explicit memory reuse uses the bounded manual intake or an explicitly installed user-level hook. Ordinary source-first work is not memory-primed.
